meta_description:
43K likes, 75 comments - eattripclick on February 3, 2026: "Cooking with Kabir is a lot of fun and also an essential part of his everyday learning.

He wanted to make his favorite chocolate pancakes and we got everything delivered quickly from @amazondotin. Once he was done with unboxing, we got down to the recipe.

And yes it came out so so delicious. Here’s to making more memories with him and helping him learn these little things on his own.

#HarDinBehtar #AmazonIndia #FatherSon #LoveCooking".
